task: Build a mech standing on its own two feet: a torso, two arms and two legs, every limb joined to the body. About 20 cells tall, mirror-symmetric across X. Give it a glowing element — at least one emissive voxel. Around 10 to 26 cells wide and 4 to 16 deep, using between 400 and 6,000 voxels.
notes: Five parts that must end up as one piece, with the joints being exactly where a limb ends up one cell short. The emissive requirement checks that material flags are reachable at all; voxel_count is bounded above so a solid block of a mech doesn't pass.
